result.description: Web data platform: proxy networks, Web Unlocker, SERP API, scraping browser, scrapers and ready-made datasets.
result.auth_detail: REST API: account API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Proxy network: username/password (native access). OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, scope mcp) exists only for the remote MCP server, not the REST API.
result.access_detail: Signup is self-serve and a default API key is created with the account. Usage is pay-as-you-go. The MCP README says new accounts get 5,000 free requests a month with no credit card required. Some products (residential network, Web Unlocker without an SSL certificate) may need KYC. I did not find a minimum deposit.
result.api_notes: API-access products: Web Unlocker, SERP, Scraping Browser, Scrapers, Functions (Scraper Studio) and Marketplace/Datasets. Proxy networks use native proxy credentials. The search snippets also mention account-management and proxy-management API pages, but I did not read those pages. The API reference introduction page returned the authentication content.
